iconPacks.name: Lucide
iconPacks.about: The icons Ghost.md was drawn with from the start: rounded lines of one weight on a 24 grid, with the app’s wash inside them. Lucide grew out of Feather and is kept by its community.
iconPacks.author: Lucide Contributors

outline.label: Outline
outline.words: Its own line, at its regular weight

solid.label: Solid
solid.words: The same lines at a heavier stroke, as Lucide lets them be set

filled.label: Filled
filled.words: Lucide has no filled set: each icon’s body is filled and the lines inside it cut out, and an icon of lines alone is its Solid

solid.label: Solid

filled.label: Filled
